Baidu (BIDU) Shareholder Platinum Investment Management LTD Has Cut Its Position; Ifrah Financial Services Lowered Its Holding in Apple (AAPL) by $356,252
May 25, 2018 - By Elijah Rosenthal
Kerr Neilson decreased its stake in Baidu Inc (BIDU) by 88.45% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Platinum Investment Management Ltd sold 626,066 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.38% with the market. The hedge fund run by Kerr Neilson held 81,714 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $19.14 million, down from 707,780 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Platinum Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Baidu Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $85.66B market cap company. The stock increased 2.22% or $5.34 during the last trading session, reaching $245.62. About 3.20M shares traded. Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) has risen 36.72% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.17% the S&P500.
Ifrah Financial Services Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ifrah Financial Services Inc sold 2,108 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 24,451 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.14M, down from 26,559 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ifrah Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $931.71B market cap company. The stock increased 0.75% or $1.41 during the last trading session, reaching $189.56. About 10.05 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Platinum Investment Management Ltd, which manages about $22.00 billion and $3.77 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Weibo Corp (NASDAQ:WB) by 71,990 shares to 400,016 shares, valued at $41.39 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Equifax Inc (NYSE:EFX) by 233,603 shares in the quarter, for a total of 697,703 shares, and has risen its stake in Alphabet Inc.
Analysts await Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) to report earnings on July, 26. They expect $2.15 EPS, up 6.44% or $0.13 from last year’s $2.02 per share. BIDU’s profit will be $749.77M for 28.56 P/E if the $2.15 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.25 actual EPS reported by Baidu, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -4.44% negative EPS growth.
